question: Navreh is primarily celebrated by which of the following communities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kashmiri Pandits**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Navreh** is a significant festival celebrated primarily by the **Kashmiri Pandit community**.
 
• The term **"Navreh"** is derived from the Sanskrit word **"Nav Varsha,"** which translates to "New Year."
 
• This festival marks the beginning of the **New Year in the lunar calendar**, which is followed by Kashmiri Pandits.
 
• Navreh is celebrated on the first day of the **Chaitra Navratri**, which typically falls in the month of **March or April** as per the Gregorian calendar.
 
• The celebration is closely tied to **nature** and involves various rituals that symbolize renewal, prosperity, and gratitude.
 
• A traditional practice involves preparing a **thali (plate)** filled with rice, flower
